title: Manual stock addition
subtitle: Temporarily add products to stock so that sales can continue without interruption.
unavailable: Product stocks could not be loaded. Please try again.
shift_required: Start your shift to add stock manually.
product_search: Type at least 2 letters of the product name
product_search_hint: Type at least 2 letters to find a product.
help: This is a temporary safety fuse. Saving increases stock and leaves a manual-adjustment audit trail; it does not confirm production.
saved: Stock has been increased. The view will refresh.
invalid: Choose a product and enter a positive whole number.
conflict: The product stock changed in the meantime. The list will refresh.
failed: Stock could not be added. Please try again.
network: The save result was not confirmed. Retry without changing the data.
